description:
SPLIT OUT of task #77 in s461aq, when half (a) (callee->caller return-family
transfer, Kind-A `raw-return-family`) shipped.  Half (b) is untouched.

THE GAP: `_tw_walk_funcall_args` (Pl/VarAnnotator.pm) gives every argument of
every user sub the use class 'opaque' â the value escapes into the callee, so
nothing about it can be proven.  That one line is why `f($q)` boxes $q even
when f only ever numifies its parameter.  The transfer would classify each
named sub's PARAMETER uses in the sub_info pre-pass â the same walk half (a)
now runs over the returns â and hand the per-position class to the call site.

WHY IT IS BIGGER THAN HALF (a): a return is ONE value leaving the sub and the
proof is local to its expression.  A parameter is an ALIAS (@_ aliases the
caller's boxes), and a callee that WRITES a parameter writes the caller's
variable â exactly what sub_info's `writes_args` already records for the
opposite reason.  So the transfer must be: use classes only where writes_args
is false, and half (a)'s closed-world rules (no methods, no coderefs, no
AUTOLOAD, bail on glob redefinition) all still apply.

MEASURE FIRST, as half (a) should have: half (a) changed the emission of 4
files in 405 and of 0 in the 111-file corpus, so the coverage it bought is
small.  Count the call sites where an argument use is the ONLY thing keeping
a name boxed BEFORE writing any code â `tools/emission-ab.pl --env` with the
arm stubbed to a fixed class is a one-run estimate.

SIZED s462as (round 19).  RECOMMEND DECLINE — measured, not guessed.

WHAT WAS MEASURED.  `_tw_walk_funcall_args` passes the use class `undef`
(-> 'opaque') for every argument of a callee that is not in %USE_FN.  Stubbing
that to 'num' is a one-run upper bound on the coverage the transfer could buy,
because 'num' is the most permissive class the transfer could ever hand over.
Population: every .pm and .t under lib/ + cpan-tests/ plus perl-tests/*.t =
535 files, `tools/emission-ab.pl --env`.

    stub applied to EVERY unknown callee (builtins, methods, coderefs too)
        79 / 535 files DIFF, 0 RCDIFF
    stub applied ONLY where the transfer could be SOUND — a KNOWN user sub
    (`$ctx->{known_subs}{$fname}`) with writes_args FALSE, which is #77(a)'s
    own closed world plus the @_-aliasing rule
        3 / 535 files DIFF, 0 RCDIFF
        (Test::Tester.pm, YAML-Tiny t/lib/TestBridge.pm, lib/warnings.pm)

3 of 535 is SMALLER than half (a)'s 4 of 405, and half (a) was already the
small half.  And the 3 are an over-estimate in the wrong direction: the names
that flip are `$desc`, `$expect`, `$result`, `$name`, `$block`, `$code`,
`$data`, `$nyn`, `$roundtrip`, `$message` — description STRINGS, CODE REFS and
data structures, which the stub calls numeric because the stub asserts 'num'
unconditionally.  A correct transfer would read the callee's parameter uses
and give most of them 'str' or 'opaque', so they would not move at all.  There
is no measured shape in any population where the transfer buys a raw slot.

WHY IT IS ALSO BIGGER THAN HALF (a).  A return is one expression and
_sub_return_facts classifies it with VarAnnotator's own oracle.  A PARAMETER
is not a name until the callee's own `my ($a,$b) = @_` runs, and the other two
spellings (`shift`, `$_[i]`) do not name it at all — so the transfer needs a
new per-POSITION use classification inside the callee, keyed through three
different parameter idioms, before it has anything to hand the call site.

A HAND-BUILT BEST CASE DOES NOT EVEN FLIP.  `sub add1 { my $v = shift; $v + 1 }
my $q; for my $i (1..$n) { $q = $i; $s = $s + $q + add1($q) }` — the shape the
transfer is for — still emits `$q` BOXED with the stub on, because the name
carries a SECOND opaque use besides the argument (num=1/opaque=2 becomes
num=2/opaque=1, still not uniform).

WHAT WAS CONFIRMED ALONG THE WAY (no bug): a PROVEN raw slot still aliases
correctly through @_ today.  `sub f { $_[0] = 99 } my $q = 1 + 2; f($q)` writes
99 into $q under PCL exactly as under perl 5.40.3 — #189's writes_args marks
the argument, which keeps the name boxed.  The 'opaque' arg class is a
SEPARATE, stricter blocker that only gates the B-regime, so removing it could
not have reached the aliasing rule.

RE-OPEN IF: a population appears where numeric values are routinely passed to
non-writing helper subs (a numeric-heavy CPAN dist), or if the callee-side
parameter classification gets built for another reason and this becomes a
consumer rather than the whole cost.


=== CLOSED (s473r, 2026-09-07) ===
Flipped to completed WITHOUT re-measuring: RECOMMENDED DECLINED and SIZED
already (DECIDED grep "#924 is RECOMMENDED DECLINED": 3 of 535 files move, and
those three are strings/code refs a correct transfer would not move).  The
numbers and the re-open condition are in the text above.  Closed by the s473r
brief`s standing instruction that a closed lever with numbers is a result.
subject: Perf: #77 half (b) â caller->callee param use-class transfer so f($q) need not be an opaque use
